# NalamDesk Docs

> Offline-first practice management for small clinics. Encrypted local vault, no cloud records.

- User Guide: https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/user-guide/intro
  - Initial Setup (vault creation): https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/user-guide/initial-setup
  - Admin Management (users, roles, security, catalogs, ABDM, audit): https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/user-guide/admin-management
  - Clinic Operations (registration, queue triage, vitals, consultation): https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/user-guide/clinic-operations
  - Daily Collection and Day Close (receipts, review queue, ledger): https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/user-guide/daily-collection
  - Merging Duplicate Charts (preview, rollback, archive): https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/user-guide/patient-merge
- Data and Backups (schedule, retention, restore): https://docs.nalamdesk.com/docs/backups
- Marketing site: https://nalamdesk.com/
